lead.headline: Tuten sat out Thursday too — two Sunday checks, still no move today
lead.deck: Tuten (ankle/foot) has two DNPs; Wilson limited again in the protocol; Boston, the cover, missed Thursday with the toe.
lead.body: The bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten did not practise on Thursday either, so Friday's report decides his Sunday. Garrett Wilson was limited again and has not cleared the concussion protocol, and Denzel Boston — his first cover — missed Thursday too, though Monken calls it a little toe issue. None of it moves the lineup today: the lineup as set is the projection lineup. At 10:30 Sunday, if Tuten is out, Warren slides to RB and Metcalf takes the FLEX; if Wilson is out, Boston if active, otherwise Metcalf. Isaiah Likely opens the week tonight with McCarthy off the injury report. Woody Marks hit Chem's wire this afternoon, the same day he missed practice and Montgomery returned — a pass.
